flipToBack.timing: Required after-trigger on isTableChanged (automatic, singleton). Three mutually exclusive branches by retarget state (default = Luke; ModifyGameTextType.BRING_HIM_BEFORE_ME__TARGETS_LEIA_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE / TARGETS_KANAN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE).
flipToBack.prose: Flip if the target character (Luke by default; Leia or Kanan if retargeted) is a CAPTIVE - spotted anywhere with INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE. No requirement that Vader captured or escorts the captive; any capture qualifies.

flipToFront.timing: Required after-trigger on isTableChanged (automatic, singleton). Same three retarget branches.
flipToFront.prose: Flips back if the target (Luke default / Leia / Kanan) can NOT be spotted as (captive OR presentWith Vader) - i.e. target is neither a captive nor present with Vader (or has left the table).

children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.Luke, Filters.or(Filters.captive, Filters.presentWith(self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.Vader))))

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: card-state check (canSpot captive target) - not control/occupy; capture by ANY means suffices; capturer identity is NOT checked
flipToFront: negated canSpot of (captive OR presentWith Vader) - keeping the back requires target captive or physically present with Vader

auto-capture engine (front, via end-of-game action proxy): isTableChanged + target not captive + canBeTargetedBy(TO_BE_CAPTURED) + Vader presentWith target, Vader not leaving table and not escorting anyone -> CaptureWithSeizureEffect (required trigger)
retarget chosen-state: deploying 'Kanan, Rebel Infiltrator' via the objective's Luke download sets TARGETS_KANAN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE for remainder of game
typedIdentities: Filters.Luke / Filters.Leia / Filters.Kanan (personas; branch by ModifyGameTextType)
Persona.SIDIOUS / Filters.Emperor (your download); Persona.LUKE / LEIA / KANAN (opponent downloads)
Filters.Scanning_Crew (may not be played); Filters.presentAt(Filters.Throne_Room) + Filters.not(Filters.frozenCaptive) (back duel gate)
